Your responsibilities: - Deliver online grocery orders to customers' homes and offices - Provide friendly and professional customer service - Process customer payments when required - Load the delivery van before starting your route - Sort returned items such as empty bottles, cans and crates - Check deliveries and orders for accuracy Every day is different because you drive a different route and meet new customers. Working hours You will work in a two-shift schedule: - Morning shift: 06:00 - 15:00 - Afternoon shift: 15:00 - 23:00 You must be flexible and available to work weekends. Over het bedrijf Albert Heijn has been one of the largest and most well-known supermarket chains in the Netherlands for over 130 years. Every day, thousands of customers rely on Albert Heijn's grocery delivery service. As a Delivery Driver in Roosendaal, you will become part of a professional and international team where you can work independently, develop new skills and grow within the organization. Wat wij vragen - Own accommodation - Category B driving licence - Good communication skills in Dutch or English - Willingness to work in shifts and during weekends - Good physical condition, as you will deliver groceries, shop...
